description: This PHP class defines a console command 'LocationCommand' for managing project location data, including checking and fixing unlocated projects using owner data or Google geocoding.

classes.name: LocationCommand
classes.description: A console command class for managing project location data, including checking and fixing unlocated projects.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command name, description, options, arguments, and help text.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command logic: filtering projects, checking owner and Google locations, and optionally fixing unlocated projects.
